hypothesis: To determine whether quantile regression models estimated using the asymmetric Laplace distribution provide more accurate Value-at-Risk (VaR) estimates at the 5th percentile compared to Gaussian error models, as measured by lower pinball loss.
author: coder-agent
success_criteria: If the Bayesian quantile regression model achieves lower pinball loss than the Gaussian model, the hypothesis is supported. If the Gaussian model performs better or similarly, the hypothesis is refuted.
notes: Gaussian error model achieved lower average pinball loss (0.000720) than Bayesian quantile regression (0.000893). Hypothesis refuted.
